note: DATE-SETMONTH-001, CLOSED at zero. This was a ratchet of 30 sites; every one is fixed and the gate is now hard, so an empty list is the point rather than an accident. Date.setMonth OVERFLOWS rather than clamping - 31 March minus one month is 3 March, not 28 February - which makes the bare `d.setMonth(d.getMonth() +/- n)` idiom wrong on about four days in twelve of every year and silently right the rest of the time. Use subtractMonths / addMonths / monthsBetween / termEndDate from supabase/functions/_shared/date-months.ts, re-exported for the Node and browser trees as @shared/date-months. Do not re-populate this list: a fix belongs in the code, and a list of known-bad sites is somewhere a new one hides.
